I recall with perfect clarity my earliest dreams, but Ihave never understood them. Next to dreams, my dearestmemories areof games. Onegameinparticularisthebloodofmyheart, for in youth it was the circumference of my hopes. It is asingular game; its natureis cryptographic, &its playverysimple:each year, all who are of age propose a solution to the cyphercalled Eliza’s Riddle. Acorrect solution earns its author a nameimmortal & the right to install a new cryptogram in place ofEliza’s, which shall stand until broken by another.The game is said to have arrived at Oldenbarnevelt withFrançois Adriaanvander Kemp,whomayhimselfhavelearneditfromthe Oneida in the vicinityof NieuwRo�erdam. It will not shock the reader to learn I was part ofthis set. The serious players in my class were few; in retrospect,none were so intolerably serious as I.
